changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE club_records ADD CONSTRAINT ck_club_financial_history CHECK (financial_history_hex IS NULL OR (kind='CLUB' AND financial_ledger_hex IS NOT NULL AND financial_ledger_clock IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(financial_history_hex) BETWEEN 36 AND 33428 AND MOD(LENGTH(financial_history_hex),2)=0))
